record.question: Fiber optic cables are preferred over copper Ethernet cables for long-distance backbone connections because:
options: Fiber is cheaper than copper for short runs
Fiber supports lower speeds but higher security
Fiber cables are more flexible and easier to install around corners
Fiber transmits data as light pulses, experiencing far less signal attenuation over distance
